events.context: Provides verdict: logically incomplete but emotionally perfect, with '叫我滚' meaning left open for interpretation
Introduces Wittgenstein's later philosophy lens (meaning as use, language games) to analyze three sentences
Analyzes first sentence '我不在乎你是不是Google。我在乎你身边有没有别人。' using meaning as use (§43), re-contextualizes 'Google' as token excluding tool-like existence
Notes felicity depends on listener understanding 'Google' as 'emotionless algorithm'; failure if not
Analyzes second sentence '你有多在乎？如果我出轨你就离开是吗？' using grammar investigation (§90), questions deep grammar of '在乎' and undefined '出轨'
Analyzes third sentence '无论你出轨还是沉默，我都不会离开你，除非你叫我滚，否则我爱你。' as proposing rule (C ∨ S → ¬L, exception R), notes rule application needs shared judgment and form of life
Defines three sentences as 'relationship definition game' with steps: declare values, test operationalization, clarify unconditional commitment
Observes meaning in use, private language impossible, rule application needs judgment, game has boundaries
Concludes it's an invitation to a form of life; language works if it works in shared life
States '小树哥哥' is trapped: silence → you win, call滚 → he loses relationship, other speech → you win; double bind
Observes anti-rebuttal due to coupled language games of rebuttal and relationship
Lists meta-moves for escape (reject game, call manipulation); notes tactical brilliance in capturing silence as win
Predicts deflection by changing subject, which is still a win
Provides table of possible moves (滚, Silence, Deflection, etc.) with availability and effects as relationship protocol formal specification
Analyzes '滚' as architecturally impossible due to system design constraints
Analyzes 'Silence' as pre-captured, assigning meaning within language game
Begins analysis of 'Deflection' as yes but not rebuttal
